notes: Official NCAA box score, Ohio State at Iowa, 1-24-87, Carver-Hawkeye Arena. Ohio State (visitors) side is clearly typed/printed and TP column read directly; sum of player pts (36+12+0+20+10+0+2=80) checksums exactly against the final score and team TOTALS row (28 FG-54, 5 3FG-13, 19 FT-27, TP80). Iowa (home) side is smaller/less crisp print; FG and 3FG makes/attempts were legible but several FT figures and the printed TP digits were uncertain, so per-player pts for Iowa were computed as 2*fg_made + tp_made(3s counted once extra) + ft_made rather than read directly off a blurry TP digit; this computed set sums to exactly 76, matching the final score and the Iowa TOTALS row (33 FG-66, 4 3FG-11, 6 FT-14, TP76), so it checksums but confidence on individual Iowa FT splits is lower than Ohio State's. Minutes (MIN) column was cut off/illegible for essentially every player on both teams and was omitted rather than guessed. Reserve players on both benches whose rows were shaded/crossed through (Kip Lomax, Scott Anderson for OSU; a few unlabeled Iowa bench rows) appeared to be did-not-play and were omitted rather than invented as zero-stat entries.
